text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Say, would everyone like to go on a
camping trip
together?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
A camp trip? Nice, I could get a lot of
relaxing
done.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Camping takes a lot of preparation,
though. After
all, we would even have to
pitch a tent ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh... O-of course, I didn't think about
that.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I just happened to see a show about
camping on
TV. Getting to see the night
sky with everyone
seemed so nice...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But I guess it would be too hard for
beginners like
us, huh.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, and of course there's the whole
matter of the
campfire to consider. It'd
be best to go with
someone more
experienced—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Sure, but you'd be there, King. You're
super
first-rate, so it'd probably be no
problem for you
to handle.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
With you around, I bet everything would
be
smooth sailing. Right?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...R-right! A matter as simple as camping is no trouble at all for me!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...I need to read up on camping, fast.
